articles.title: How market depth shapes the price of a weekend Bitcoin sale
articles.description: Over 14 hours, Bitcoin traded on Kraken’s Canadian dollar market at an average 37.3% discount to a benchmark based on the exchange’s US dollar trades.

articles.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid ongoing intelligence probe
articles.description: Nvidia shares surged nearly 29% after the company’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following consultations with the US government.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
articles.description: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.

articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX
articles.description: The miner can borrow against its Bitcoin to fund operations and expansion after selling about 465 BTC to cover expenses in the third quarter.

articles.title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks
articles.description: Strategy raised its preferred stock buyback limit to $4 billion and authorized the transfer of up to $1 billion from its dollar reserve.

articles.title: AI agents are using credit cards. Where does that leave crypto?
articles.description: AI agents are already using credit cards to transact, raising questions about where crypto fits in the emerging agent economy.

articles.title: Critics of Netflix’s FTX drama point to Obama’s producer credit
articles.description: Series creator Graham Moore said he invented a scene in which Changpeng Zhao urges Alameda Research to trade ahead of FTX customers’ orders.

articles.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
articles.description: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.

articles.title: BTC price gains 12% from $55K: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 3.1% before Monday’s open, while Wednesday’s US inflation report could shape expectations for a December rate hike.

articles.title: ‘MoldyRoost’ ads can steal crypto wallet recovery phrases from iPhones

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.8B in third-largest weekly outflow
articles.description: Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $4.14 billion in November through Friday, nearing June’s $4.51 billion total.

articles.title: Trump renews call for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
articles.description: In a Truth Social post on Monday, Trump said rehiring Jensen Huang would benefit both Nvidia and the US.

articles.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman warns Fed will make a rate ‘mistake’ in December
articles.description: Markets and economists widely expect the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in its December meeting.

articles.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges

articles.title: Will Bitcoin’s big rebound hold? More tampered Ledgers found: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Bitcoin rebounds sharply from its new cycle low, but is $55,111 really the bottom? Ledger investigates new reports of tampered devices in Berlin and the UAE.

articles.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
articles.description: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
articles.description: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

articles.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
articles.description: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

articles.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty

articles.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
articles.description: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

articles.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
articles.description: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

articles.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
articles.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
articles.description: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

articles.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff

articles.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act

articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off

articles.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client

articles.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
articles.description: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.
